_about: Mini catalogue for the en-GB search golden tests. Every row is a real public USDA FoodData Central name and fdc_id (Foundation, SR Legacy or Branded), taken from a full FDC import. Branded rows are the adversarial matches observed in docs/plans/canonical-foods-plan.md section 1.2, plus a few right-food branded rows. No other source. Rows 739 onwards are the anchors of the canonical-foods CSV (app/canonical_foods/canonical_foods_en_gb.csv), so the golden tests can run with the canonical layer loaded.
